summary: Over 1,100 runners from 26 states completed India's highest border run from Jyolingkong (15,000 ft) to Gunji amidst -18°C temperatures, organized under UTDB and the Vibrant Villages Programme.
publishedAt: Official Event Bulletin • Vyas Valley Desk
headline: Adi Kailash Parikrama Run 2.0 Concludes in Vyas Valley: Digember Singh & Meenakshi Negi Win 70KM Ultra
source: Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board (UTDB) & ITBP Gunji Command
fullDetails: Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board (UTDB) and Pithoragarh District Administration successfully held the 2nd Edition of the Adi Kailash Parikrama Run from October 24 to 26, 2026.

The flagship 70KM Ultra started at Jyolingkong (4,600m / 15,000 ft) beside Parvati Sarovar, concluding at Gunji (3,200m / 10,500 ft). Digember Singh from Chamoli won Men's Ultra (4:45:36) and Meenakshi Negi from Pauri Garhwal won Women's Ultra (5:44:14).
Full race report, complete podium results across 42KM, 21KM, 10KM, 5KM, and MTB challenge are now available in the GoTrek official blog article.

summary: Alliance Air 42-seater flights to Naini Saini Airport (NGH) operate 6 days a week from Delhi (80 mins, 11:00 AM departure) and 5 days a week from Dehradun (45 mins, 01:55 PM departure). GoTrek airport 4x4 pickups available.
headline: Daily Direct Flights from Delhi & Dehradun to Pithoragarh: Alliance Air Schedule & Timing Confirmed
fullDetails: Delhi to Pithoragarh: Departs Delhi (IGI) at 11:00 AM, arrives Naini Saini Airport at 12:20 PM (1 hr 20 min). Operates 6 days/week (Mon-Sat).
Dehradun to Pithoragarh: Departs Jolly Grant Airport at 01:55 PM, arrives at 02:40 PM (45 mins). Operates 5 days/week (Tue-Sat).
Pithoragarh to Delhi return departs 02:10 PM; Pithoragarh to Dehradun return departs 12:45 PM.
GoTrek provides direct airport tarmac pickup and dedicated 4x4 Bolero transfer from Naini Saini Airport to Dharchula (3 hrs).
source: Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Directorate & Alliance Air RCS Ops
